svg.title: The built-in types as sets. Values are primitives or objects. Among the primitives, int is inside ratio, inside real, inside complex. rand-seed is the same set as int. unit, the reals from 0 to 1, is inside real and overlaps int and ratio. bool, string, color, point, none and each list type are separate. Among the objects, every shape type is inside shape, every motif type is inside shape, and every variant of a motif is inside that motif. ease, curve and colormap are inside func, font is inside record, views, controls and listeners are inside component, and every animation type is inside movement. scene, formula and term are separate.
